snippet.title: Alien Grounds - Early Access Trailer (Archived)
snippet.description:
This is an older trailer from the Early Access period. Watch the current official trailer here: https://youtu.be/QPZEbIQGCgA

Alien Grounds is a single-player sci-fi FPS with weird weapons, relentless robots, and score-focused gameplay.

Play on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3351550/Alien_Grounds/

Developed by emagnetic
